description: Core 14: the two methods MUST NOT be used simultaneously. Profile parameters in the Accept of a request with an RPP-Profile header are 400 with RPP-Code 02001.
comment: Skipped on rri-mtest: MTEST's config signals the profile by media type; the twin in profile_signalling_media_type/ covers it.

steps.comment: Reads the discovery document, with Content-Type application/rpp+json, Accept application/rpp+json; profile="urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base"; profile-version="1.0", RPP-Profile profile=urn:ietf:params:rpp:profile:base;version=1.0; expects 400 02001. The error answer this case checks.
